ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_rankgap_exp_weighted_softplus_loss
ir.intuition: This loss shifts paradigm to a rank-based signal by leveraging the rank gap between pairs, instead of advantage gap, and applies an exponential weighting to emphasize pairs with larger rank differences. It replaces logsigmoid with softplus for smoother gradients and uses a weighted mean aggregation, encouraging stronger discrimination for more significant rank gaps. This paradigm shift from advantage-gap margin to rank-gap weighted preference accommodates a more ordinal perspective of pairwise preferences.
ir.pseudocode:
rank_diff = batch['delta_rank']
log_prob_w = batch['log_prob_w']
log_prob_l = batch['log_prob_l']
weight = batch['weight']

# Weight pairs exponentially by rank difference magnitude
weights_scaled = weight * exp(abs(rank_diff))

diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
loss_terms = softplus(-diff)

loss = sum(loss_terms * weights_scaled) / sum(weights_scaled)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']
    abs_rank = ops.abs(delta_rank)
    weights_scaled = ops.mul(weight, ops.exp(abs_rank))
    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    loss_terms = ops.softplus(ops.neg(diff))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_terms, weights_scaled)
    total_weight = ops.sum(weights_scaled)
    return ops.div(ops.sum(weighted_loss), total_weight)
